identity_audit.identity: exact category/subcategory/title/abstract/url; time + last20 canonical history + unordered exposure IDs
identity_audit.duplicate_event_policy: exclude every matching large user conservatively

dataset.note: User-disjoint, same historical period; not a future-time or real signup test

selection.selection: main 0/1/3/5, two scenarios, Recall50; seed42 only

guard.rule: n>=100, user bootstrap lower95>0, two-sided sign-flip Holm8<=0.05

notes: First100 hash-selected users per cohort, all scenarios/budgets; fixed rotating method order
No HTTP, database or text encoder request cost; catalog size recorded explicitly
Resident models and prebuilt SID index; index construction included only in initialization time
SID-only uses the existing shared channel builder, including its auxiliary content/CF work
Shared host, CPU only; peak RSS includes all loaded baselines, not isolated adapter memory
Generation/DNN bypassed entirely for rejected guard groups; no future feedback used
User-disjoint same-period evaluation, not a future temporal holdout or HN signup test
Sparse fused AUC and dense content/DNN AUC have different support; primary endpoint is full-catalog Recall50
Three model seeds are averaged within user, not counted as independent users
Primary nine tests Holm-corrected; per-budget and cohort intervals exploratory
Union100 is an oracle coverage diagnostic with up to 300 candidates, not a fair-budget recommender
new_items means added to the frozen small catalog, not a verified publication-date cohort
